run_profile_tui_single_shot: run the Hermes TUI performance profiler for a single session with default page_up hold for 8 seconds
run_profile_tui_loop_mode: run the Hermes TUI profiler in loop mode that auto-rebuilds and re-runs on TypeScript source changes
run_profile_tui_compare: run the Hermes TUI profiler and diff results against a previously saved baseline metrics file
summarize_perf_log: summarize the Hermes perf.log file by parsing JSON lines and filtering events newer than a given timestamp
format_diff_metrics: format a side-by-side A/B comparison table showing delta and percentage change between two sets of performance metrics
